title: Mongo: replica-set healthcheck
description: Runs `nexus health mongo`: quorum, single-primary, and per-secondary replication-lag probes.

observe.what: quorum 3/3 (>= majority) green · exactly-1-PRIMARY green · per-secondary lag (<10s green) · overall=green

whatProves: MongoAdapter.HealthAsync derives quorum/primary/lag probes from a single rs.status() projection and rolls them into an overall status.
